item.title: US Marshals Service declares suspected child killer Travis Decker dead; sheriff awaits DNA confirmation
item.description: Federal prosecutors sought to dismiss the case against Travis Decker, accused of killing his three daughters, after the US Marshals declared him dead. However, Chelan County officials are awaiting DNA results for confirmation, as remains were found on Grindstone Mountain with items believed to belong to Decker.

item.title: Trump–Epstein statue: ‘Best Friends Forever’ artwork dismantled overnight
item.description: A controversial statue depicting Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein holding hands was swiftly removed from the National Mall due to permit violations. The Secret Handshake, the activist art group behind the installation, claims the removal was improperly executed and criticizes it as an attack on free expression.

item.title: Charlie Kirk assassination: Suspect Tyler Robinson to remain in ‘special housing unit’ despite mental health evaluation
item.description: Tyler Robinson, accused of assassinating Charlie Kirk, remains in a special housing unit after a mental health evaluation, according to the Utah County Sheriff’s Office. While the evaluation is complete, authorities are keeping Robinson in the unit due to concerns like violent behavior or the nature of the crime.

item.title: ‘Until it stopped breathing’: Pennsylvania woman charged after remains of 4 infants found; reportedly killed them over 6 years
item.description: In a shocking case from western Pennsylvania, Jessica Marie Mauthe faces homicide and abuse charges after the remains of four infants were discovered in her former residence. The landlord's discovery of the decomposed remains in a closet led to Mauthe's arrest. Authorities allege she gave birth to and killed the infants over six years.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Yemen drone attack: Projectile strikes Israeli city of Eilat; over 20 injured
item.description: A drone launched from Yemen struck Eilat, a city in southern Israel, injuring at least 22 people. Two individuals are in serious condition due to shrapnel wounds. The attack, which occurred near a hotel in a shopping district, follows a previous Houthi drone strike on a Red Sea resort hotel. The Iron Dome interceptors failed to stop the drone.

item.title: ‘Critical incident’: Three students injured in stabbing at Carrick High School, Pittsburgh; suspect in custody
item.description: A critical incident unfolded at Carrick High School in Pittsburgh on Wednesday morning, resulting in at least three students being injured in a stabbing. Pittsburgh Public Safety confirmed that a student used a small knife, leading to a lockdown and a swift response from police, firefighters, and EMS.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Never sought to build nuclear bomb’: Iran president at UNGA; blames European powers for acting in 'bad faith'
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian addressed the UN General Assembly, asserting that Iran has never pursued nuclear weapons and maintains a peaceful nuclear program. He criticized European powers for acting in bad faith regarding the 2015 nuclear deal, especially after the U.S. withdrawal. Pezeshkian also condemned recent Israeli and U.S. strikes, highlighting their negative impact on global trust and regional peace.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Safety mechanism’: UN rules out sabotage behind Trump's escalator stopping abruptly, says it was a feature
item.description: President Trump faced technical issues at the UN headquarters in New York, including a stalled escalator and a malfunctioning teleprompter. The UN stated the escalator stopped due to a safety mechanism possibly triggered by a videographer. Trump joked about the incidents, but US officials are investigating whether the escalator malfunction was intentional.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: H-1B visa fee hike: Donald Trump's immigration curbs shatter Indian students' dream; now considering alternative destinations
item.description: Donald Trump's proposed H-1B visa fee hike, potentially reaching $100,000, has jeopardized the aspirations of numerous Indian students seeking education and careers in the US. This policy shift prompts many to explore alternative destinations like Canada, the UK, and Australia, while countries like Germany and China actively attract international talent, potentially impacting America's global competitiveness.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Jimmy Kimmel Live! Returns: The Comedic, the Tragic, and the Politics - and why the joke is on America
item.description: Trump didn’t even have a functioning teleprompter. And yet he was funnier, than Jimmy Fallon, Stephen Colbert, John Oliver, and any other “comedian” that clings to a desk at 11PM and pretends to be America’s “conscience.” He was born with better comic timing than their monologues ever had. Every rally he holds is essentially a comedy special, complete with callbacks, audience interaction, and improv. No writers’ room, no punch-up meetings—just a septuagenarian free-styling nonsense that makes his crowd laugh harder than any Kimmel bit.
item.dc:creator: Nirmalya Dutta

item.title: US president approval poll: Economy no longer Trump’s strength; here is what he does better in the second term
item.description: President Trump's political strengths have shifted, with the economy no longer a major advantage, particularly among independents. He now relies on border security and crime, though approval on crime has dipped slightly. While foreign policy remains steady, support regarding the Israeli-Palestinian conflict has decreased across party lines, impacting his overall approval ratings.
